name: Mobile Number Validation — Invalid Pattern Entered
goal: User enters a mobile number with all identical digits; bot rejects and re-prompts until valid number is given.
constraints: User first enters '9999999999', then a valid number.

phases.description: Bot asks for mobile number; user enters all identical digits.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects input, displays correct error, and re-prompts.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
